requirements_summary: Primary workload: code search + context-aware reranking. Corpus size: 50M-200M embeddings initially; expected growth 2x Y/Y. Re-indexing: incremental nightly + bulk weekly; some repos update in near-real-time (minutes). Latency targets: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 250ms for similarity + rerank end-to-end. Throughput: 300 qps sustained during peak. Cost sensitivity: target <$0.005 per query end-to-end (embed + search + rerank). Model preferences: open LLMs for reranking (ability to run quantized LLMs on dedicated GPUs), prefer local private deployment or dedicated VPC with KMS. Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to smaller quantized model for heavy load. Security: SSO/SAML, enterprise SSO, audit logs, retention controls, EU data residency for some customers. Must support canary rollouts and A/B rerank tests.
sales_notes: PRIYA: 'Must not expose source code to third-party models; encryption-at-rest and per-tenant keys required.' Interested in Redwood Dedicated or Private. Wants clear recompute/cost model for nightly re-index vs incremental updates. Request: sample benchmark for 100M corpus with p95 latency and cost breakdown. AE pushing for Dedicated trial; legal needs DPA + SOC2 evidence. Finance wants ARR estimate and TCO comparison vs self-hosting.
technical_notes: Requires embedding pipeline integration: existing pipeline uses Jina/FAISS hybrid; will evaluate Redwood's vector store/router options.
Rerank flow: candidate retrieval (ANN) -> lightweight embeddings similarity -> LLM reranker that has repository context. Must support token streaming and tool calls for in-house enrichment.
Frequent reindexing: need delta update API and idempotent upsert behaviour; retention policy per-tenant for audit compliance.
KV/prefix cache desirable to lower p50 latency for repeated dev queries. Suggest Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and caching.
Expectation: ability to pin model versions, run canary rerankers, and rollback automatically to cheaper model under capacity pressure.
